Subprocessor List

Last updated: 6 September 2026

Providers supporting the Platform

The providers below support delivery of enterlabs. Their involvement depends on the deployment and features used. The applicable Client agreement governs subprocessor authorisation, changes and international transfers.

ProviderServiceRelevant data
PT Codemasters Nusantara InnovationIndonesian implementation, configuration and supportClient data accessed as needed to provide these services
Amazon Web ServicesApplication hosting, databases, object storage, backups and disaster recoveryPlatform data stored or processed in the managed deployment
Microsoft AzureAzure OpenAI inference and Azure AI Document IntelligenceDocument-processing inputs and outputs used by these services
Google Cloud PlatformEmbedding processing and Pub/Sub messagingData submitted through the relevant integrations
SprintoCompliance management and breach-record storageCompliance evidence and incident records that may contain personal data
BrevoAccount-email integration, where enabledRecipient email addresses and account messages, including OTP and reset information

Processing locations

Managed application hosting and S3 storage are in AWS Jakarta. Disaster-recovery resources are in Singapore. Azure AI Document Intelligence is configured in Southeast Asia. Azure OpenAI's documented Global Standard deployment may process inference requests across Microsoft's global infrastructure.

Other processing locations depend on the provider service and applicable configuration. This list does not promise that all processing remains in a single country. Deployment-specific information is available through sales@enterlabs.ai.

Monitoring components

SigNoz and OpenTelemetry support tracing through a collector hosted in Jakarta. Traces may include request identifiers, function arguments and exceptions. These are software components, and their use does not by itself mean their software vendors receive Client data. Uptime Kuma is used for self-hosted availability monitoring.

Website and business services

Website hosting and business-contact services, including Google Workspace and monday.com, are addressed in the Privacy Policy. Google Cloud Artifact Registry is used in deployment pipelines and is not listed as a separate document-processing service.

Changes and questions

Subprocessor notifications and approvals follow the applicable Client agreement. To request information or receive relevant updates, email sales@enterlabs.ai with the subject "Subprocessor notifications".
